papers.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
papers.desc: After an older adult misses a medication dose, a software agent can send another reminder and an embodied agent can bring the medication.

papers.title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
papers.desc: Building interactive digital twins requires recovering both 3D geometry and the kinematic structures that govern how objects articulate.

papers.title: AdvFD: Boosting Visual Generation via Adversarial Fr'echet Distance Loss
papers.desc: Fréchet distance has recently emerged as an effective distribution-level objective for generator post-training, complementing the conventional sample-level diffusion and flow-matching losses.

papers.title: Ex-Omni-2D: Expressive Omni-Modal Dialogue Models with Native Visual Presence
papers.desc: Omni-modal dialogue models can understand multimodal inputs and synthesize spoken replies, yet their responses remain visually disembodied.

papers.title: Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness
papers.desc: Large language model evaluations typically focus on performance under nominal conditions, creating an illusion of capability where models comfortably walk a narrow, highly optimized generation corridor.

papers.title: Not Worth Another Token: Marginal Value Estimation for Efficient Deep Research Agents
papers.desc: Long-horizon research agents solve open-ended tasks through iterative retrieval, aggregation, and synthesis, but context grows rapidly while the marginal value of additional evidence often declines.

papers.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
papers.desc: Long-document understanding often requires reasoning over many visually rich pages, making inference costly and prone to context rot.

papers.title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
papers.desc: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers expand recommendation capacity through conditional computation, yet a trained checkpoint still stores and routes over its full expert bank.

papers.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation
papers.desc: We study reference-free post-training for multilingual machine translation with open large language models.

papers.title: 360CityArena: A Realistic Virtual Urban Navigation Benchmark for Embodied Agents
papers.desc: We present 360CityArena, a benchmark for evaluating the urban exploration capabilities of embodied agents within a photorealistic environment constructed from 360-degree videos.

papers.title: DistilVDR: A Compact End-to-End Visual Document Retriever via Dual-Student Distillation
papers.desc: Visual document retrieval (VDR) is dominated by multi-billion-parameter models that are slow to index at full corpus scale and expensive to serve.

papers.title: iFAN: Inference-Aware Learning for Plain Mask Transformers
papers.desc: Query-based mask transformers assemble segmentation outputs through pixel-wise competition among query predictions of the final layer, yet this inference process is not explicitly optimized during training.

papers.title: TSDS-Toolbox: A Toolbox for Measuring Time-Series Dataset Similarity
papers.desc: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly accelerated research in time-series analysis, particularly in forecasting, classification, and generation tasks.

papers.title: JigShape: Evaluating Visual-Geometric Reasoning in VLMs through Jigsaw Puzzles
papers.desc: Jigsaw puzzle solving requires jointly reasoning about visual content and geometric constraints, yet existing benchmarks use rectangular cuts that create ambiguous ground truth in texture-repeated regions.

papers.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference
papers.desc: The Large Language Model from Power Law Decoder Representations (PLDR-LLM) and its attention, Power Law Graph Attention (PLGA), replace the fixed bilinear form of scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) with a learned, input-generated bilinear operator G_{LM}, built from a positive tensor A_{LM} by elementwise power laws.
